statement: Cyclic quadrilateral $ABCD$ in $\omega$. $F=AC\cap BD$, $E=BA\cap CD$. Projections of $F$ on $AB,CD$ are $G,H$. $M,N$ midpoints of $BC,EF$. If the circumcircle of $\triangle MNG$ meets $BF$ only at $P$, and circumcircle of $\triangle MNH$ meets $CF$ only at $Q$, prove $PQ\parallel BC$.

For positive integer $n$, let $f(n)=\min_{m\in\mathbb{Z}}|\sqrt{2}-m/n|$. If $\{n_i\}$ is strictly increasing and $f(n_i)<C/n_i^2$ for some constant $C$, show there exists real $q>1$ with $n_i\geq q^{i-1}$.

$n$ balls numbered $1,\ldots,n$ are arranged on a circle. For three clockwise consecutive balls $i,j,k$: $j$ is red if $i>j>k$; yellow if $i<j<k$; blue if $i<j,k<j$; green if $i>j,k>j$. Find the number of distinct coloring methods (two methods are distinct if some ball gets different colors).
Given integers $n,k>1$, non-negative reals $a_1\geq\cdots\geq a_n$ summing to 1, and $c_1,\ldots,c_n$ with $\sum_{i=1}^m c_i\leq m/k$ for all $m$. Find the maximum of $\sum c_ia_i^k$.

$P$ inside $\triangle ABC$ with $PL:PM:PN=BC:CA:AB$ where $L,M,N$ are midpoints of $BC,CA,AB$. Extensions of $AP,BP,CP$ meet the circumcircle at $D,E,F$. Prove the circumcenters of $\triangle APF$, $\triangle APE$, $\triangle BPF$, $\triangle BPD$, $\triangle CPD$, $\triangle CPE$ are concyclic.
Find all $r\in(0,1)\cap\mathbb{R}$ such that there exists $S\subseteq\mathbb{R}$ with: (i) for any $t$, exactly one of $t,t+r,t+1$ is in $S$; (ii) for any $t$, exactly one of $t,t-r,t-1$ is in $S$.
